tasks.title: Book Candid Photographer & Drone Clearance
tasks.description: Sign contract with cinematic videographer; obtain venue drone permissions.

tasks.title: Review Floral Mandap 3D Stage Mockup
tasks.description: Verify marigold arch dimensions, seating height, and brass thali setups with decorator.

tasks.title: Send Digital RSVP & Google Maps Location Pin
tasks.description: Broadcast WhatsApp invites with interactive schedule and parking instructions.

tasks.title: Assemble Return Gift Bags & Sweets Boxes
tasks.description: Pack 200 eco-jute hampers with Mysore Pak and jasmine saplings.

tasks.description: Coordinate Mehendi artist for bride & close bridesmaids; iron out Muhurtham attire.

tasks.title: Venue Walkthrough & Sound Check with Nadaswaram Troupe
tasks.description: Inspect stage lighting, test microphones, and confirm generator diesel backup.

tasks.title: Coordinate Breakfast Catering Delivery & Welcome Staff
tasks.description: Ensure hot filter coffee & idli station are live by 7:00 AM for early Muhurtham arrivals.

tasks.title: Confirm Catering Menu & Tasting Session

tasks.title: Vendor Final Confirmation & Schedule Walkthrough

tasks.title: Execute Event Day Hospitality & Stage Program
tasks.description: Greet guests, oversee catering rounds, and coordinate stage ceremony.

inspirations.title: Brass Urli & Floating Jasmine Welcome Foyer
inspirations.description: Place three antique brass urlis filled with water, floating orange marigolds, tuberoses, and scented floating candles at the arrival walkway to greet guests with gentle fragrance.
inspirations.culturalContext: Traditional South Indian Mangala Vaadya welcome with auspicious water & flower symbolism.

inspirations.title: Interactive Live Filter Coffee & Steaming Holige Bar
inspirations.description: A rustic brass counter where fresh Mysore Pak and hot Bele Holige (Puran Poli) are roasted on tawa with desi ghee, served alongside metre-long froth filter coffee in traditional davarah-tumblers.
inspirations.culturalContext: Celebrates authentic Karnataka culinary hospitality with interactive spectacle.
